subject: Redwood pilot - next steps / contract redlines

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot - next steps

Hi Leah —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Goal: Validate LLM-powered search & summarization in Acme’s support portal (reduce AHT, improve deflection).
- Scope: ~50k monthly queries, mixed short/long context.
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in repeat tickets, sub-400ms 95th percentile latency for typical queries.

Next steps I suggested on the call: 
1) Redwood dev trial access (2 weeks) — we’ll provision a sandbox workspace and a sample pipeline.
2) Pilot sizing & pricing doc — Jonas will share the recommended config and estimate.
3) Security/compliance touchpoint — Leah, you mentioned you’d loop in procurement and legal.
4) Contract/PO cadence — target start week of Apr 12 if procurement clears.

If that looks right, I’ll send a calendar invite for the sandbox kickoff and Jonas will follow with the pilot config.

Thanks again — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0142
